tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and calendar day cells. Near-black with a slight red bias.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, KPI tiles, alert pills, the week-total column of the calendar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover state of tiles and rows, session tags, calendar nav buttons.

tokens.name: day-out
tokens.usage: Calendar cells outside the displayed month.

tokens.name: tip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders, table header rule, axis lines, gaps between KPI tiles.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Calendar grid gaps, chart grid lines, table row rules, empty bar tracks.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers on bg, surface, surface-2 and tip-bg (15:1 and more).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: KPI descriptions, metadata, chart tick labels, tooltip body. 7.2:1 on surface, 6.7:1 on tip-bg.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary labels only: eyebrows, column headers, hints. 3.4:1 on surface and 3.6:1 on bg: below 4.5:1, so never body copy; kept for small uppercase labels as in the source.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The one accent. Brand word, key numbers (hot KPI, countdown), race and quality sessions, today ring, focus ring, the primary chart series. 5.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind quality sessions and the race row of the week list.

tokens.name: red-line
tokens.usage: Accent borders: race chip, critical alert, tooltip frame, nav button hover.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill (race chip, critical pill, FRACT and RACE tags). 3.7:1: keep it bold, or 19px and up; small regular text on red fails AA.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary chart series (chronic load), slow share of the intensity bar, info alerts, cadence target band. Validated against red for colour-blind separation.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text on a cyan fill. 6.0:1.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state only: 'À surveiller' alerts, pain markers, the 5'45 threshold line. Never a data series.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill. 8.6:1.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Positive state only: 'Stable' pill. Always with its word.

tokens.name: on-good
tokens.usage: Text on a good fill. 8.4:1.

tokens.name: type-ef
tokens.usage: Left rule and legend swatch of endurance (EF) sessions.

tokens.name: type-tempo
tokens.usage: Left rule of tempo and progressive sessions.

tokens.name: type-sl
tokens.usage: Left rule of long runs (SL).

tokens.name: ev-ef-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a completed EF session chip.

tokens.name: ev-tempo-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a completed tempo or progressive session chip.

tokens.name: ev-sl-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a completed long-run chip.

tokens.name: sl-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the SL tag in the session log.

tokens.name: sl-tag-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the SL tag, on sl-tag-bg. 6.9:1.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark, uppercase, 'Further' in red. Clamp to 34px on phones.

styles.name: kpi-value
styles.usage: Big number of a KPI tile; unit in kpi-unit next to it. 34px on phones.

styles.name: week-total
styles.usage: Weekly km in the calendar's last column.

styles.name: day-number
styles.usage: Day number in the week agenda.

styles.name: kpi-unit
styles.usage: Unit beside a kpi-value, in fg-2.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Tooltip titles, race name, session names.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values and column headers, in fg-3.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every figure in rows and summaries; tabular numerals.

styles.name: data-small
styles.usage: Chip metadata, pills, chart tick labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between chips in a day, inside label/value stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: KPI tile inner stack, split rows, legend rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Alert pill gap, nav buttons, grid gaps in rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Week-agenda row padding, glossary card gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a panel's heading and its content; tooltip padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, KPI tile padding, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections and between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Maximum page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bar data-ends, log tags, split bars.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Session chips, alert icons, intensity bar.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, week-agenda rows, mobile day cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Calendar frame, tooltip, glossary cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, KPI rail, race chip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Alert pills and status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-tip
tokens.usage: Tooltip only. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: stroke-series
tokens.usage: Chart lines.

tokens.name: stroke-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid and axes.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, in red, offset 2px; the today ring in the calendar.

tokens.name: rule-type
tokens.usage: Left rule of a session chip, coloured by session type.
